title: Safe lookup
prompt: Return the value stored under key in data. If the key is not there, return -1 instead of crashing. Try running the starter as-is to see what the crash looks like.
hints: Check whether the key exists before reading it.
`if key in data:` return data[key], else return -1.

docs.name: key in data
docs.what: true if the dictionary has that key.

docs.name: data.get(key, default)
docs.what: Returns the value for key, or default when the key is missing.
